throughput.source_quote: Delta Petroleum Corporation is an E&P company; no crude refining throughput

warnings: CAUTION: This CIK (821483) was Delta Petroleum Corporation (E&P company) in this period, not a petroleum refiner. No commodity hedges in place as of June 30, 2002; filing states hedging would begin in fiscal 2003. This entity later became Par Petroleum Corporation, then Par Pacific Holdings after acquiring Hawaii refinery in September 2013.
